items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: He played dance music too. Ray was a composer. I think he's a member of VASCAP.

ctx.x: He played dance music too. Ray was a composer. I think he's a member of VASCAP. He gets a check. Well you recorded one of his tunes. What? Well, I was getting back to the guitar and the banjo.
When you had your society orchestra, you'd stick to Biloxi and so forth, a sort of society type of orchestra where you had a larger than a Dixieland group anyway. Oh yes.
